description: Paid, $0.25 in USDC on Base, settled per call over x402 — no key, no account. Ask a specific question about Bitcoin, Ethereum, altcoins or macro. An agent picks the live market-data tools it needs (prices, funding rates, open interest, Fear & Greed, macro rates), runs them, and returns one JSON object: regime, confidence, the numbers behind the call, bull and bear scenarios, the level that invalidates it. Calling without payment returns the price and a sample of the output, and costs nothing.

context.description: Optional free-form context to take into account.

language.description: Language of the text fields. Defaults to en.

question.description: The question to answer, e.g. "Is BTC funding overheated right now?"

name: analyze_market

invalidation_level.description: Price level that invalidates the call.

key_data.description: The concrete numbers behind the call, metric name to value.
